howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The video is re-encoded as VP9 WebM — smaller files at the same quality, ideal for HTML5 video on the open web.

faq.a: WebM uses VP9, which is royalty-free and often produces smaller files than H.264 at the same quality. Ideal for hosting video on the open web.
Every modern desktop browser plays WebM. Safari on iOS supports it from iOS 16 onward. For maximum compatibility, MP4 is still safer.

faq.q: How much smaller will it be?
faq.a: Typically 20–40% smaller than the equivalent MP4 at the same visible quality.
